events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey board files, probes and github references
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls workshop-plan/*.mjs | head -30; ls workshop-plan/tasks | head -40; ls cloud | head; grep -c "github" workshop-plan/tasks.html workshop-plan/tasks/*.py 2>/dev/null; git log --oneline -5 -- workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs workshop-plan/probe-board-actions.mjs; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py 2>&1 | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find remaining GitHub references in board, Worker and task scripts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n -i "github" workshop-plan/tasks.html workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py workshop-plan/tasks/runner.py workshop-plan/tasks/sync_board.py workshop-plan/tasks/overflow.py | cut -c1-260; ls cloud/board; wc -l cloud/board/* 2>/dev/null | tail -8; grep -n -i "github" cloud/board/*.js cloud/board/*.toml 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-220 | head -30; tail -5 workshop-plan/tasks/github-poll.log | cut -c1-200; tail -4 workshop-plan/tasks/board-sync.log | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the stale GitHub mentions in board page, pass.py and runner.py
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 770,800p workshop-plan/tasks.html | cut -c1-400; echo ----; sed -n 205,226p workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py; sed -n 338,346p workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py; sed -n 628,640p workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py; echo ----; sed -n 8,18p workshop-plan/tasks/runner.py; sed -n 800,808p workshop-plan/tasks/runner.py; echo; grep -n "window.open\|target=._blank\|issues/new" workshop-plan/tasks.html | cut -c1-200 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the live public board probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; date; node workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs --live > /tmp/t322-pub.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; grep -c -i "^ *ok\|✓" /tmp/t322-pub.log; grep -i -n "fail\|✗\|error" /tmp/t322-pub.log | head -20; tail -4 /tmp/t322-pub.log | cut -c1-300

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the live public board probe from workshop-plan
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; date; node probe-public-board.mjs --live > /tmp/t322-pub.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; date; wc -l /tmp/t322-pub.log; grep -i -n "fail\|✗\|not ok" /tmp/t322-pub.log | head -20; head -5 /tmp/t322-pub.log | cut -c1-200; tail -4 /tmp/t322-pub.log | cut -c1-300

events.text: Public board probe is clean (exit 0). Now running the board actions probe and checking the remaining items.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Count probe passes and read how the actions probe runs
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; grep -c "^  ok" /tmp/t322-pub.log; sed -n 1,30p probe-board-actions.mjs | cut -c1-220; grep -n "github\|Pause\|agent" probe-board-actions.mjs | cut -c1-200 | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check which spec items the public probe output covers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; grep -n -i "github\|visitor\|LAN\|trust\|download\|cap\|hash\|forward" /tmp/t322-pub.log | cut -c1-230; sed -n 178,183p probe-board-actions.mjs | cut -c1-260; lsof -iTCP:8899 -sTCP:LISTEN -n -P | tail -1 | cut -c1-80

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the board actions probe without toggling the live agent
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; echo "LC_AGENT_RUN=${LC_AGENT_RUN:-unset}"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "8899 %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8899/tasks.html; date; LC_AGENT_RUN=1 node probe-board-actions.mjs > /tmp/t322-act.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; date; grep -c "^  ok" /tmp/t322-act.log; grep -n "FAIL\|Error\|sandbox" /tmp/t322-act.log | cut -c1-250 | head; grep -n "github" /tmp/t322-act.log; tail -3 /tmp/t322-act.log | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: See how the public probe posts a note on the live page
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; grep -n "live\b\|--live\|LIVE" probe-public-board.mjs | cut -c1-240 | head -30; grep -n "\.fill(\|\.click(" probe-public-board.mjs | cut -c1-200 | head -20; python3 tasks/pass.py 2>/dev/null | grep -n -i "sandbox\|probe" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the note-send selectors and the probe round trip
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; grep -o "WHO=[^;]*;" tasks.html | head -2; sed -n 80,90p probe-public-board.mjs | cut -c1-330; sed -n 138,156p probe-public-board.mjs | cut -c1-260; grep -n '"rm"' tasks/pass.py | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Create a sandbox task, post one test note from the live board through the old address, time its arrival
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; T=$(LC_AGENT_RUN=1 python3 tasks/pass.py add "title=Board probe sandbox (T-322 live note check)" area=Infra priority=P2 status=queue owner=Claude "spec=Sandbox for one live-board test note signed probe; never acted on; removed after the check." | grep -o "T-[0-9]*" | head -1); echo "sandbox $T"; echo $T > /tmp/t322-sandbox
